'''Dustdiver''' was a dangerous profession in class-three comet [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. Dustdivers would come to the surface of the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] in [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuits]] and then mine valuable minerals such as [[Thorilide/Legends|Thorilide]] directly. Minimal gravity, deadly crevices and the danger of the comet vaporizing under the rays from the nearby [[Star/Legends|star]] made this job most hazardous. In the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] it was one of the highest-paid jobs, though some organizations, like the [[Sungrazer cooperative]], preferred to use slaves instead of paying for it.
